$comment: sherpa-dialog — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: a modal surface on the native <dialog>: modality, ::backdrop, focus trap, ESC and top-layer come from showModal().

props.name: data-heading
props.description: the title of a composed sherpa-container-header; a slotted [slot=header] replaces it

props.name: data-status
props.description: status colour cascade (critical | warning | success | info | urgent)

props.name: data-type
props.description: modal | overlay — overlay fills its container and opens NON-modal, so the page beside it stays live

props.name: open
props.description: native boolean (read reflects dialog.open; set → show()/close())

slots.name: header
slots.description: header region (reflects has-header): a header of its own, in place of data-heading's

populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

capabilities.description: callable from a view definition's state block (show, hide, close, prompt, confirm). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.
answers a commandfor button's command (--show, --hide). See $extensions.sherpa.commands.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Open it: a modal goes to the top layer with a backdrop; an overlay stays in place.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Ask for ONE value. Its first field shows `value`; its LAST footer button answers with what the field holds, and any other button, or Escape, with null. An empty answer keeps it open.

methods.name: confirm
methods.args: ask: { heading?: string; words?: string; action?: string; critical?: boolean } = {}
methods.description: Ask yes or no. `words` go in its first paragraph and `action` on its LAST footer button, critical when the ACTION is; what is not given stays as the markup wrote it. True for the action, false for anything else.

divergence.note: 2026-09-07 (D2/D12): split out of the former Container Type=dialog variant into a standalone component on native <dialog> (showModal → modality, ::backdrop, focus-trap, ESC free). Maps to the Figma "Dialog" component (Container set already split).

_divergence.overlayType: 2026-09-24: data-type="overlay" is code-only. It fills its container (the app shell's overlay slot), opens NON-modal, and closes on ESC. Figma's Dialog has no such variant yet.

jsProps.name: open
jsProps.description: whether the dialog is open (delegates to <dialog>)
